messages:
Sam: Alert: asia2 GPU queue saturated, preemptible evictions spiking. latency SLOs breaching for small-batch requests. PagerBot triggered @pager.
PagerBot: [alert] asia2-gpu-queue > 85% saturated. evictions ↑ 40% in 10m. paging oncall: Sam -> primary. link: https://metrics/redwood/asia2-gpu
Sam: I'm taking this. quick check: is autoscaler stuck? 
Maya: hitting quota on nodepools — GCE is returning RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on new instances. looks like region quota got hit during the batch replays.
Jin: confirming — kube events show failed scale-up: "Insufficient regional quota: some resource".
Arc: copying runbook snippet: 
```
runbook: asia2-gpu-evictions
1) check nodepool quotas: gcloud compute regions describe asia2
2) if quota hit, shift non-critical workloads to eu-west2.
3) bump reserved capacity if immediate recovery needed.
```
Maya: @Sam we can do a fast failover: update route table to shift new inference traffic to eu-west2 for low-latency tiers, keep batch on asia2. will cause higher cost for that slice.
Sam: do it. can you update paging rules too? if autoscaler continues to fail we want second-level escalation to Arc. current PagerBot only paged primary.
Maya: will update PagerBot policy now — increasing escalation timeout from 6m -> 3m for asia2-gpu alerts and add Arc as second responder.
OncallBot: config update: pagerrule asia2-gpu: escalation_timeout=180s, escalation_targets=[Sam,Arc]. applied by Maya.
Jin: I can kick manual evac for low-priority pods to free GPUs: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -l workload=noncritical -n inference` then reschedule to eu-west2. However image pull might slow things.
Sam: proceed with manual evac, but avoid evicting warm cache pods. add label keep-warm=true to exclude.
Maya: doing traffic shift now: updating traffic-routes service asia2->eu-west2 for route group gen-lowlatency. Command: `infractl route update --from asia2 --to eu-west2 --routes gen-lowlatency --weight 100`
PagerBot: deployment event: route update started by Maya.
Arc: FYI this will temporarily raise per-token cost ~1.8x for the shifted traffic. we should notify finance if sustained.
Sam: noted. create a short incident tag and cost ticket after stabilization.
Maya: autoscaler logs show repeated 403 from cloud quota API during scale attempts. raising to GCP support, case id: 2026-ASI-889.
Jin: manual evac completed for noncritical workloads. used selector: workload=noncritical AND keep-warm!=true. freed 18 GPUs. node autoscaler retrying.
Sam: CPU/latency graphs are returning toward normal. still seeing some evictions inflight but throughput stable.
PagerBot: [resolved?] asia2-gpu-queue back to 62% utilization. no new evictions in 4m.
Maya: updated incident channel and pinned runbook + support case. adding a postmortem placeholder.
Arc: we should tweak autoscaler backoff: reduce backoff from 60s->30s for scale-up attempts during quota errors so we can retry quicker once quota opens. will open a PR to infra autoscaler.
Jin: noted for follow-up. also recommend pre-warming an emergency reserved pool (small commit) in asia regions during peak window to avoid cold quota hits.
Sam: agree. Also tweak PagerBot workflow: when RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED is in the scale event, escalate to cloud-ops group immediately rather than waiting.
Maya: did the PagerBot rule update include that condition?
Sam: not yet, I'll file the update now.
Sam: @Arc @Maya created ticket INF-5689 to add reserved pool prewarm + autoscaler backoff change + PagerBot condition.
Arc: 👍 once we have postmortem we can evaluate cost tradeoffs.
Maya: closing the immediate paging flow: setting incident status -> monitoring. Will keep channel open for 30m then handoff to daytime oncall.
Sam: handoff plan: current oncall to hand to Day-2 at 1800 UTC. leaving notes: quota case open, route shifted, 18 GPUs freed, cost impact flagged.
OncallBot: Handoff scheduled: Sam -> Day-2 at 1800 UTC. reminder 10m prior.
Jin: small follow-up: a few pods restarted with OOM after eviction; created k8s ticket K8S-243.
Sam: thanks team. good job. :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup: closing thread after handoff.
